title: Localized radial homotopy formula with a compactly supported primitive: K₁(dγ) = γ − dψ on ball(0, ρ)
statement:
Let P, q ∈ ℕ and ρ ∈ ℝ, and write ι_xα := α.curryLeft x. For a (q+1)-form β on ℝ^P and a (q+2)-form α put
 (K₀β)(x) := ∫_0^1 t^q·ι_x(β(t x)) dt,  (K₁α)(x) := ∫_0^1 t^{q+1}·ι_x(α(t x)) dt.
Assume (H): for every C^∞ (q+1)-form β (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β: smoothness order ∞, not analytic), K₀β is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), and d(K₀β)(x) + K₁(dβ)(x) = β(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P (d = exteriorDerivative).
Then for every test form γ ∈ 𝒟^{q+1}(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ (q+1)) there is a test form ψ ∈ 𝒟^q(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ q) with K₁(dγ)(x) = γ(x) − dψ(x) for every x with ‖x‖ < ρ.
(H) is exactly the statement of dimred_cs_sos_cfs_radial_homotopy at (P, q). The selected node discharges it when it assembles its children.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • y)).curryLeft y) x + (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (exteriorDerivative β (t • x)).curryLeft x) = β x) → ∀ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1), ∃ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) q, ∀ x : Euclid P, ‖x‖ < ρ → (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (exteriorDerivative (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) (t • x)).curryLeft x) = (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x - exteriorDerivative (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) q) x
